easy: A person who is one of the leaders in a group that makes decisions or watches over something.

easy: In the bottom spot, closest to the ground.

ex.en: The branch hung lowest, so I could pick the apple.
ex.ko: 그 가지가 가장 낮게 늘어져 있어서 나는 사과를 딸 수 있었다.

easy: Having to do with Mexico or its people.

ex.en: We ate Mexican tacos for dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁으로 멕시코 타코를 먹었다.

easy: A person who comes from Mexico.

ex.en: My neighbor is a Mexican who plays the guitar.
ex.ko: 우리 이웃은 기타를 치는 멕시코 사람이다.

easy: A fall flower with many thin petals.

ex.en: Mom put a yellow mum on the porch.
ex.ko: 엄마는 현관에 노란 국화를 놓았다.

easy: The thing that matters most, so you do it first.

ex.en: Homework is my first priority after school.
ex.ko: 방과 후에는 숙제가 나의 첫째 우선순위이다.

easy: Ads and messages that make people want to buy or try something.

ex.en: The movie's promotion was on every bus.
ex.ko: 그 영화의 홍보가 모든 버스에 붙어 있었다.

easy: Moving up to a better job or a higher level.

ex.en: My aunt got a promotion at work.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 직장에서 승진했다.

easy: Helping something grow or become popular.

ex.en: The promotion of reading helps kids love books.
ex.ko: 독서 장려는 아이들이 책을 좋아하게 도와준다.

easy: A very good person that the church honors after he or she dies.

ex.en: Saint Nicholas is a famous saint known for giving gifts.
ex.ko: 성 니콜라스는 선물을 주는 것으로 유명한 성인이다.

easy: To take something that is not yours.

ex.en: The raccoon tried to steal our snacks.
ex.ko: 너구리가 우리 간식을 훔치려고 했다.

easy: To move quietly so nobody sees you.

ex.en: The cat stole across the yard.
ex.ko: 고양이가 마당을 살금살금 가로질렀다.

easy: In baseball, to run to the next base while the pitcher is throwing.

ex.en: He tried to steal second base.
ex.ko: 그는 2루를 도루하려고 했다.

easy: Learned or gotten from life, not born with you.

ex.en: Liking spicy food can be an acquired taste.
ex.ko: 매운 음식을 좋아하는 것은 후천적인 취향일 수 있다.

easy: Being joined with others so you can help each other.

ex.en: The two countries kept their alliance for many years.
ex.ko: 두 나라는 여러 해 동안 동맹을 유지했다.

easy: A group of people or countries that agree to work together.

ex.en: Several countries formed an alliance to keep the peace.
ex.ko: 여러 나라가 평화를 지키려고 동맹을 맺었다.

easy: Making you feel bothered or a little angry.

ex.en: The buzzing fly was so annoying.
ex.ko: 윙윙대는 파리가 너무 성가셨다.

easy: To say how much money you will pay for something.

ex.en: Dad bid ten dollars for the old bike at the sale.
ex.ko: 아빠는 경매에서 낡은 자전거에 10달러를 불렀다.

easy: To say a greeting or a wish to someone.

ex.en: We bid our grandparents goodbye at the airport.
ex.ko: 우리는 공항에서 조부모님께 작별 인사를 했다.

easy: A close friend.

ex.en: My buddy and I ride bikes to school.
ex.ko: 내 단짝과 나는 자전거를 타고 학교에 간다.
